workspaces.description: MA Lighting grandMA2 onPC v3.9.63.6 — full show control software running via Wine. Connects to grandMA2 consoles and NPUs over MA-Net2.
workspaces.notes:
Requires Docker Run Config Override: {"network_mode": "host", "user": "root"} — host networking is mandatory for MA-Net2 multicast console discovery (UDP 6549). Art-Net on UDP 8000, sACN on UDP 5568. GrandMA2 onPC launches automatically on desktop open.

1.19 fallback uses KasmOS desktop because the original custom image is not currently present/publicly pullable. Replace with the native custom image once published.

go.cmd: bash -c "WINEPREFIX=/home/kasm-user/.wine wine '/home/kasm-user/.wine/drive_c/Program Files (x86)/MA Lighting Technologies/grandMA2 onPC/grandMA2 onPC.exe'"

workspaces.description: NousResearch Hermes Agent dashboard — self-improving personal AI with memory, skills, and 200+ models. Backend runs persistently in WSL2.
workspaces.notes:
The Hermes backend (gateway + dashboard) runs persistently in WSL2 Docker. This workspace opens a browser pointing at the Hermes dashboard on the host.

First-time setup: the hermes and hermes-dashboard containers must be running in WSL2. See /opt/hermes-agent/ for the compose files.

go.cmd: bash -c "if ! curl -sf --max-time 3 http://172.17.0.1:19500/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker rm -f kasm-setup-trigger 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name kasm-setup-trigger --restart unless-stopped -p 172.17.0.1:19500:19500 -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v /root/.openclaw:/data/openclaw -v /root/.hermes:/data/hermes -e DATA_DIR=/data ghcr.io/perspective0labs/kasm-setup-trigger:latest; sleep 5; fi; curl -sf --max-time 20 http://172.17.0.1:19500/ensure-hermes || true; DISPLAY=:1 chromium-browser --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage --app=http://172.17.0.1:9119 2>/dev/null"

workspaces.description: NousResearch Hermes Agent with Kori-x real-time dashboard. Built-in s6-overlay supervision runs the gateway, built-in dashboard, and Kori-x monitoring UI together in one container.
workspaces.notes:
Set Proxy Port to 5173 for the Kori-x monitoring dashboard, or 9119 for the built-in config/session dashboard, or 8642 for raw API access.

Default model: qwen2.5-coder:7b-32k (local Ollama via LiteLLM proxy at 172.17.0.1:4001).

Mount a persistent volume at /opt/data to preserve config, API keys, sessions, skills, and memories across workspace restarts.

Ports: 8642 (OpenAI-compatible API + health), 9119 (built-in dashboard), 5173 (Kori-x UI), 3001 (Kori-x WebSocket), 3002 (Kori-x wiki API).

Unreal Engine 5.8 editor (dev-slim) — full Linux editor and build tools for real-time 3D, virtual production and pixel streaming projects.
workspaces.notes:
Requires GPU agent (gpu_count >= 1) and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit installed on the agent host. Will not run usably on CPU-only agents.

IMPORTANT: ghcr.io/epicgames/unreal-engine is NOT anonymously pullable. The Kasm agent must hold GHCR credentials for an account linked to the EpicGames GitHub organisation, or the pull fails.

First pull is ~49 GB — allow time and disk headroom on the agent.

Projects persist in /{username}/unreal (bound to ~/Documents). The shader cache is persisted separately at ~/.config/Epic; without it shaders recompile on every session.

This image is an Epic image, not a Kasm image — it carries no KasmVNC layer. If no desktop appears on launch, a wrapper image (FROM kasmweb/core-ubuntu-jammy + engine files) is required; see docker-builds.

workspaces.description: Unreal Engine pixel streaming runtime — runs packaged UE projects and streams the rendered output. Runtime only, no editor.
workspaces.notes:
Runtime only — this image contains no editor. Package your project in the Unreal Engine workspace, then mount or copy the packaged build into /{username}/unreal-packaged and launch it here.

Requires GPU agent (gpu_count >= 1) and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the agent host.

IMPORTANT: ghcr.io/epicgames/unreal-engine is NOT anonymously pullable — the Kasm agent needs GHCR credentials for an EpicGames-linked account.

The base image is small (~0.5 GB) because it ships runtime dependencies only; your packaged project supplies the content.

This is an Epic image, not a Kasm image — it carries no KasmVNC layer, so it is intended for headless streaming rather than a browser desktop.
